title: RNG failure mapped to misleading KeyDerivation error
description:
File: oscore/src/edhoc/initiator.rs:178-179

Issue: `rng.try_fill_bytes(&mut eph_seed[..]).map_err(|_| OscoreError::KeyDerivation)` discards the actual RNG error and maps it to `KeyDerivation`, which is semantically incorrect. An entropy source failure is not a key derivation failure.

Impact: Debugging entropy issues becomes harder; callers cannot distinguish RNG problems from actual KDF failures.

Suggested fix: Add a dedicated error variant or use a more appropriate existing one:
```rust
.map_err(|_| OscoreError::EntropyFailure)  // new variant
// or at minimum:
.map_err(|e| { log::warn!("RNG failed: {:?}", e); OscoreError::Internal })
```
close_reason: Already fixed: External oscore crate (patched from /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore) now correctly maps RNG errors to OscoreError::EntropyFailure at initiator.rs:178-179, not KeyDerivation. The EntropyFailure variant is defined in error.rs:55.
